source.author: laurentenhoor
source.text: A free outliner with Workflowy's shortcuts and Obsidian's markdown, no backend, and a Claude connector built in. Say "add that to my notes" in any conversation and it lands in your outline; ask what you wrote last month and Claude answers from it. No account to try: bulletlist.org/demo
source.title: Show HN: An outliner to replace Workflowy and Obsidian – as a Claude connector
